services.name: Residential Solar PV Installation
services.description: Residential photovoltaic system design, permitting, and installation across Marion and Alachua counties. Load calculations and shade analysis performed in-house; systems sized to household consumption with optional battery-ready wiring. NABCEP-certified PV installer on every design.

services.name: Battery Backup Integration
services.description: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ Battery, and Generac PWRcell installations for new and existing solar systems. Whole-home backup or critical-loads panel configurations supported. Integration with utility net metering and AHJ interconnection handled end-to-end.

services.name: Bi-directional EV Charger Installation
services.description: Level 2 and bi-directional EV charger installations for Tesla, Ford, and GM vehicles. Coordinates load calculations with household PV and battery systems. Vehicle-to-home and vehicle-to-grid configurations available where utility interconnection agreements permit.

guarantees.type: 25-year panel manufacturer warranty passthrough; 10-year installation workmanship

testimonials.name: Evan R.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Greenridge designed a 9.6kW system sized to our actual consumption, not a number that maxed out our roof. Permit approved first try. They worked out the interconnection with Duke Energy without a single delay on our end.
testimonials.quoteShort: 9.6kW sized to actual consumption. Permit approved first try. Duke interconnection without a delay on our end.

testimonials.name: Priya M.
testimonials.quoteVerbatim: Battery backup addition to an existing system another company installed. Greenridge redid the load calculation, caught a subpanel issue the first installer missed, and fixed it before the Powerwall went in. Real engineering, not just marketing.
testimonials.quoteShort: Battery backup addition. Caught a subpanel issue the first installer missed and fixed it before the Powerwall went in.
